relevance.rationale: WRONG JOIN. The seeded id was faddeev_kashaev1994, whose ref() entry (references.ts:6311) names the quantum-dilogarithm paper. This document is nothing of the sort: it is a single-author expository introduction to the volume conjecture for non-experts, arXiv:1002.0126 [math.GT], 31 Jan 2010 — a survey covering the definition of the coloured Jones polynomial, elementary examples, elementary hyperbolic geometry, Kashaev's invariant, and the deformed/Dehn-surgery generalisation. The correct source for faddeev_kashaev1994 is library/arxiv-hep-th-9310070v1/9310070v1.pdf, which IS that paper and is separately in this slice; so the key already has its true upload and this file was mis-attached to it. No existing ref() key matches this document: grep of references.ts for '1002.0126' and for 'Introduction to the Volume Conjecture' returns nothing, so id is null rather than corrected. Relevance in its own right is real but background-tier: the folio's volume-conjecture cone is already anchored on primary sources (kashaev1997, murakami-murakami2001, murakami2004, nguyen-tran-2021), so this survey duplicates coverage rather than adding a consumable result. Supporting, not core.

proposedActions.rationale: The document is in the folio's core subject area and would be a reasonable single-pointer survey for the volume-conjecture chapter, but it must first exist in references.ts under its own key. Until then the ledger row must carry id null so the false join to the quantum-dilogarithm key is not propagated.

Record the mis-join itself: the ledger/indexer attached this file to faddeev_kashaev1994, a key that already has its correct upload at library/arxiv-hep-th-9310070v1/9310070v1.pdf Two uploads pointing at one key is the signature of exactly this failure mode and is worth a note so the indexer heuristic can be tightened.

entry.note: Bib key backfilled from library block in references.ts. The row carried `id: null`, which read as "held but uncitable"; the join already existed on the references.ts side.
